min_col, min_row, max_col, max_row = range_boundaries(answer_range)

# Read the current used rows from column A.
last_row = ws.max_row
col_a_values = [ws.cell(row=r, column=1).value for r in range(1, last_row + 1)]

# Mark the four original rows immediately preceding every "Chassis" in column A.
rows_to_delete = set()
for idx, value in enumerate(col_a_values, start=1):
    if isinstance(value, str) and value.strip() == "Chassis":
        start = max(1, idx - 4)
        for r in range(start, idx):
            rows_to_delete.add(r)

# Simulate deleting those rows and shifting the remaining column A values upward.
remaining_values = [
    value for r, value in enumerate(col_a_values, start=1)
    if r not in rows_to_delete
]

# Write only inside the permitted answer range.
height = max_row - min_row + 1
for offset in range(height):
    ws.cell(row=min_row + offset, column=min_col).value = (
        remaining_values[offset] if offset < len(remaining_values) else None
    )

output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)
